text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: INC-INF-2376 fired -> escalation policy 'pagechain-prod' (primary -> secondary -> manager). service=hosted-inference queue=hosted-gen latency_spike P1

pagerduty: PagerDuty Alert: INC-INF-2376 (hosted-inference) — triggered by 95th percentile latency > 750ms for 3m. Escalation: primary oncall did not ack, escalated to secondary.

alice (oncall): saw the page. I'm on mobile now, trying to ack... phone kept bouncing to DND, can't ack from push.

alice (oncall): ok acked from web. seeing errors in metrics: 5xx count jumped, connection resets to model-hosts in us-east-1.

bob (sre): I'm pulling logs. preliminary: a subset of hosts in us-east-1 GC paused and kube liveness flapped -> 502s from proxy.

bob (sre): running:
```
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=model-host -o wide
# several pods in CrashLoopBackOff on node gpu-node-17
```

dmitri (eng-run): that node had a scheduled maintenance patch earlier today that didn't finish cleanly? I'm checking node events.

pagerduty: Escalation: secondary (eva) attempted page at +5m — no ack. Manager escalation fired to eva (manager).

eva (manager): I'm currently on a day off with limited reach. SMS didn't come through. hitting mobile now, joining the thread.

claire (support): what is customer impact? any degraded requests? we have multiple open support tickets.

alice (oncall): rough numbers from dashboards: ~3% of total requests are seeing 500s, spike concentrated to customers routed to us-east. Peak error rate ~8% for 10m, now down to 3%. latency p95 increased to ~1.2s globally. Active customer impact flagged: 42 customers with increased error rates; 6 customers reported visible failures.

bob (sre): mitigation plan proposal: 1) isolate failing nodes in us-east (cordon + drain), 2) promote standby pool in us-west-2 and shift traffic, 3) fall back to quantized model variant for degraded latency while we rebuild nodes.

alice (oncall): agree. starting step 1 now: cordon gpu-node-17 and drain pods.

bob (sre): draining. log tail:
```
2026-03-15T18:12:05Z proxy host=proxy-12 upstream=hosted-model-4 ERR connection reset by peer
2026-03-15T18:13:22Z kubelet node=gpu-node-17 Eviction: Pod terminated due to oomkill
```

alice (oncall): node shows repeated OOMs referencing memory leak in model shard loader. I'm reconfiguring pod memory limit for draining pods to avoid repeat crashes on reschedule.

dmitri (eng-run): pushing a temporary config to reduce model shard cache size:
```
redwoodctl apply config --service hosted-inference --set 'model.cache.size=0.6'
```

bob (sre): starting traffic shift: incremental 20% -> 50% -> 100% to us-west-2 standby. command: `redwoodctl route shift --service hosted-inference --from-region us-east-1 --to-region us-west-2 --steps 20,50,100 --timeout 120s`

alice (oncall): shifting now. observability: downstream 5xxs dropping as we move to us-west, p95 returning to baseline in 2nd step.

claire (support): draft for customers who reported: "We're aware some requests to our hosted inference API experienced elevated errors and latency between 18:10–18:25 UTC. We've routed traffic to a healthy standby region and applied mitigations; most customers returned to normal within 15 minutes. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with an incident summary." good to post?

eva (manager): yes good. add ETA for full RCA (48h) and note customer impact numbers (42 affected, 6 escalated). Also offer status page link.

alice (oncall): agreed. posting interim status to status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-INF-2376: "Mitigation applied; traffic rerouted; monitoring for regression."

pagerduty: PagerDuty: INC-INF-2376 acknowledged by alice (oncall). manager escalation cancelled after ack.

bob (sre): next steps: repro on staging to exercise shard loader memory path; increase node OOM safeguards; coordinate a rolling replace of gpu-node-17 with patched kernel. docketing RCA.

dmitri (eng-run): tagging a follow-up action: run memcheck on model-loading path and add unit to nightly e2e for low-memory conditions. I'll own the ticket.

claire (support): I've sent the interim message to impacted customers and B2B contacts. asked product for credit/compensation guidance if customers push.

alice (oncall): final check: error rate down to ~0.4% globally, p95 ~240ms. leaving a postmortem stub. marking this thread resolved for active mitigation. please add notes below with any lingering action items. :thumbsup:

bob (sre): action item list: [RCA-1] node patch + kernel; [RCA-2] shard loader mem cap; [RCA-3] routing playbook update for faster failover; [RCA-4] PD escalation policy review (sms fallback).

eva (manager): thanks team. add me as reviewer on RCA. will follow up on compensation decisions with sales.

incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigation in place). Summary: traffic shifted to us-west-2 standby; failing node isolated; temporary model cache reduction; customers mostly recovered. Follow-up RCA in 48h. :white_check_mark:
